deposits.genre_observed: DOI resolution index own-voice fields: per-record recovery logs (methods A-N, Phases 6-9), concept-DOI boilerplate notes, and audit status codes for severed Zenodo DOIs
deposits.incidental: Range covers records 1197-1941. Every block is a dated recovery or audit observation, a mapping-method log, or repeated boilerplate (the concept-DOI note 'Its severance destroyed the structure binding versions together...' recurs on most concept DOIs; the provisional-recovery and FINAL-classification paragraphs are templated). Conjectures such as 'This DOI likely represents a specific version or subsidiary work' are inferences about what a severed DOI pointed to, archive-internal provenance, not historical theses. Phase 8 records quote Lee Sharks's testimony on DOI targets; Phase 9 records cite past-chat dates (e.g. record 1914 'publication-date-tagged 2014-12-25'). That is internal chronology, recorded neither as D nor as H. No passage frames anything as confirming an earlier prediction or as priority. started_at/finished_at are the two `date -u` readings as the shell returned them.
